recent.text: Asked Pete DeBoer on the #Isles goaltending decision for the back-to-back (Varly tonight/Sorokin tmw): “It came down to two things. You got a divisional game & an out of conference game, and the other part is it gives Ilya an extra day of rest. And he's been a busy guy lately.”

recent.text: Feel awful for Palmieri, who is dealing with this for a second straight season. It was his left knee on Nov. 28 last year; right knee on Nov. 23 this year. He played 25 games last season; 23 this season. He's 35. He's 52 games away from 1,000. Hope he can recover and get there.

recent.text: Second year in a row his #Isles #NHL season ends Thanksgiving week (he was hurt last Black Friday). Watching him present flowers to Casey’s mom/wife on Wednesday, I’m sure he had to wonder - will I now get there? He’s 52 games away and could have hit it later this season.
